# **Placer**

---

This mod basically adds a new vanilla styled block called "Placer" that can place blocks as his name says.

---

Placer is a good block for making farms. For example a automatic tree farm that's because, Placer works like that when there is block infront of his face he places it after the block:

!![How it works](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e5111aa605bf688fef24255e8bfb58436e6e9aa.png)

And now the same thing but with sapling:

!![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b06f60a54061b1889fdfa64aea9cd6a82ee034d5.png)
